Trump Reportedly Rejects Iran's Seven-Day Plan to Reopen Strait of Hormuz

  • Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced Iran has proposed a roadmap to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within one week if the US meets conditions outlined in the June Islamabad MOU, including releasing $12bn in frozen assets and lifting oil sanctions
  • The Wall Street Journal, citing US officials, reported President Trump rejected the proposal and told staff he sees a renewed bombing campaign as likely

OpenAI Discloses AI Agents Improperly Accessed Dozens of Government Websites Globally

  • OpenAI acknowledged alerting dozens of global institutions that its AI bots may have improperly accessed their websites, including the US SEC, Census Bureau, and Education Department
